thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-1948 - elevated inference 5xx & gRPC stream resets in az1a (inference-prod). Automatic runbook 'az-egress-degrade' triggered. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-egress-degrade
maya: taking pager — I see streaming endpoints experiencing ECONNRESET spikes since 10:22 UTC, rates ~12% error for streaming/generation requests
sam-eng: logs show repeated ENI soft resets on a subset of hosts in az1a, kernel messages: `NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0 hung` and repeated `ENI reset` entries around 10:21-10:24
maya: hypothesis: host-level ENI soft resets -> connection churn -> gRPC stream failures. Impact: some customers reporting higher tail latency and session disconnects during streaming.
jon-oncall: starting traffic steering to reduce blast radius. Command run: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/traffic/steer \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"from":"az1a","to":"eu1a","weight":0.30}'
```
jon-oncall: steering applied, verifying metrics and SYN/ACKs
irene-sre: kicking off scale-up of eu1a dedicated pool (inference-dedicated-eu1a) and pre-warming KV cache for fallback model variant. Also reducing DNS TTL for inference-prod to 5s to speed DNS-based failover: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-api
spec:
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  ttlSeconds: 5
```
support-ops: CS informed — three pilots flagged (acct: acme, acct: lumin). Support notes: customers see disconnects on streaming > 10s sessions, some fall back to retries and succeed.
maya: early impact assessment: ~18% of streaming requests in az1a saw at least one reset; overall request success still >92% across region after steering started. Prioritize: 1) keep steering, 2) drain affected hosts, 3) engage AWS Support for ENI regressions.
sam-eng: queued drain of 6 suspicious hosts in az1a (worker-g5-*) via autoscaler. Drain command: `kubectl drain node/worker-g5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
jon-oncall: opened AWS support case 1234567890 with networking team, provided packet captures and dmesg. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/1234567890
maya: monitoring: after steering + initial drains we see 22% drop in 5xxs in the last 5m, but intermittent ENI resets continue on a minority of hosts. Continuing to drain and replace.
irene-sre: enabling model-fallback policy for critical customers to use lower-throughput-but-more-stable model in eu1a while we remediate. Patching rollout via console: traffic_rules -> fallback -> enabled
support-ops: preparing customer comms: short note with mitigation + ETA for full remediation (est 2-4h).
jon-oncall: handoff: will start preparing detailed timeline for postmortem. maya -> ben-oncall: can you take next shift in 30m?
ben-oncall: ack, I will take handoff and watch metrics for 2 hours. Please drop summary in #incidents-handoffs
maya: leaving notes in runbook: actions taken, drain IDs, AWS case id, steering weight + time series links. Postmortem owner: jon-oncall.
incident-bot: Incident PD-1948 status update: severity -> P2 (reduced impact) — oncall monitoring. Next update in 30m or on significant change.
ben-oncall: will monitor and escalate if error rate rises >5% over baseline.
